title: Fire Detection System using Webcam-based Spectrometer
description: Designed and implemented a fire detection system that uses a webcam-based spectrometer to capture real-time spectra and compare them to a reference fire spectrum. If the correlation exceeds a threshold, an alarm is triggered.

title: Hygieia: An Autonomous Floor Cleaner
description: Designed and implemented an autonomous bot for floor cleaning with an obstacle avoidance algorithm.

title: 16-bit Carry Lookahead Adder Design
description: Designed a hierarchical 16-bit Carry Lookahead Adder in CADENCE using System Verilog, verified with directed and layered testbench, and optimized for power, performance, and area (PPA).

title: IOT Based MineEnvironment & Worker’s Safety Monitoring System
description: Designed and implemented a system that can monitor real-time oxygen saturation, pulse rate of a worker, and temperature, pressure, and humidity inside an area of a mine through radio communication.
